notes: Cross-verse consistency. The chapter's three other second-attributive articles standing between an expressed head noun and a participle (11:27, 11:44, 11:50) are `unrepresented`, with the supplied relativizer riding on the participle under rule 31. This verse read the same configuration under rule 90, which is scoped to a substantival article and disclaims in terms any unit in which a head noun is expressed. τοῦ is now `unrepresented` and ἀπολομένου takes *who perished*.
